name.en: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
name.hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना

description.en: Government-funded health assurance for eligible beneficiary families, providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization at empanelled hospitals.

eligibility_rules.note: Senior citizens aged 70+ qualify irrespective of socioeconomic status; Aadhaar-based e-KYC is required for enrolment.
General-family eligibility must be checked against the official beneficiary database and applicable state rules.

application.channel: Official PM-JAY beneficiary portal / designated enrolment channel / Common Service Centre or empanelled hospital
application.instructions: Check beneficiary status in the official system. For eligible 70+ persons, follow the senior-citizen enrolment and Aadhaar e-KYC process.

grievance.instructions: Use the PM-JAY helpline/grievance mechanism or the State Health Agency/empanelled hospital grievance desk. Verify current contact details for the state.

sources.title: FAQs related to benefits for senior citizens under AB-PMJAY
sources.supports: 70+ eligibility irrespective of economic status and Aadhaar e-KYC

sources.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY official portal
sources.supports: Scheme overview and official beneficiary access; general family eligibility must be checked in official beneficiary system

verification.warning: A scheme-level status does not establish an individual's eligibility. Confirm the current state/UT implementation and official beneficiary record.

notes: Do not claim PM-JAY covers routine OPD or all medical expenses; the benefit concerns covered hospitalization packages.
For already-covered PM-JAY families, senior-citizen benefit rules differ from other 70+ households; use the NHA FAQ and current operational instructions.
The general beneficiary eligibility criteria are not fully encoded in this file.
